risks: Agent path policies are not OS or container isolation.
Reviewer context and human identity assurance remain procedural rather than cryptographic.
The deterministic scanner cannot prove global secret absence and is not DLP.
Compressed, encrypted, fragmented, unknown or multiply encoded content can evade scanning.
Windows reparse and filesystem TOCTOU risks are not eliminated.
Remote branch protection, CI, CODEOWNERS and actual staged state were not evaluated.
No controlled external evidence store was implemented.
